Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for 
the petitioners.
2. Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, learned 
Additional C.S.C. along with Mr. Bhupendra 
Koranga, learned Brief Holder for the State of 
Uttarakhand/respondent Nos.1 & 2.
3. Mr. Navnish Negi, learned counsel for 
respondent No.3.
4. It is contended by learned counsel for the 
petitioners that in the similar set of 
controversy, this Court has passed interim 
order on 13.06.2024 in WPSS No.316 of 2024. 
Since, the controversy involved in the present 
writ petition is identical, interim order can be 
passed in this petition.
5. To this proposition, learned State 
Counsel as well as learned counsel for 
respondent No.3 have not disputed the said 
submission made by the learned counsel for 
the petitioners.
6. List on the date fixed i.e. 24.10.2024,
along with connected matters. 
7. Till next date of listing, the respondents 
are restrained from interfering in the 
functioning of the petitioners to the post of 
Junior Engineer.
8. Interim relief application (IA/1/2024) 
stands disposed of accordingly.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 19.06.2024

Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
(Through V.C.)
1. Mr. M.C. Pant, learned counsel for 
the petitioner (through V.C.).
2. Mr. R.S. Bisht, learned Addl. C.S.C. 
for the State.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner 
submits that in connected petitions in 
total there are 68 petitioners in favour of 
whom the Coordinate Bench passed an 
interim order and pursuant to the said 
order 68 incumbents who are similarly 
situated are directed to continue.
4. In this petition only two incumbents 
have been left who are not permitted to 
continue only because of the reason that 
no interim was passed in their favour. If 
it is so, Mr. R.S. Bisht, learned Addl. 
C.S.C. may get definite instructions in 
the matter whether the petitioners have 
been discontinued only on the ground 
that there is no interim order in their 
favour. 
5. List this case on 27.12.2024.
6. Interim order, if any, in the 
connected petitions to continue till the 
next date of listing. 
 
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
